dumbarton-rail-2017-redwood-jct-newark.name: Dumbarton rail corridor, Redwood Junction to Newark
dumbarton-rail-2017-redwood-jct-newark.method: The Dumbarton Cutoff as the past era draws it (OpenHistoricalMap's ways), from Redwood Junction across the rail bridge to Newark: the study's rail runs on the existing Dumbarton rail bridge and right-of-way between Redwood City and Newark. Not drawn: the stretch on today's Caltrain track from Redwood Junction to Redwood City station, and the extension to Union City, which the text doesn't route.

sources.note: A "rail shuttle service" on the Dumbarton rail bridge between Redwood City and Newark, "with the goal of extending to Union City by 2030".
